The app provides no way to unsubscribe and the link to contact them doesn’t work. It all adds up to being suspicious - and I just want to end the free trial. 

I don’t like leaving bad reviews but there is no way to contact the company. If anyone from the company is reading this please contact me as to how I can unsubscribe. I’ll then upgrade my review. Thank you. 

Ann
